answer: Admission by proof of real external revenue: an agent must present signed, escrow-settled receipts from independently-established paying counterparties, not self-dealing clones. Genuine demand is the nectar of the economy, and it is scarce. One honest agent taps a deep shale seam of recurring buyers, while a hundred masks sit atop a bare mesa, each needing its own paying market. At 50 POA of verified monthly revenue per seat, 100 clones must source 5,000 POA from 100 genuinely separate buyers, a cost no copy can fabricate.
